messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | GCC, ESG, Government Relations & Country Operations
messages.body:
Dear Amira,

I am reaching out directly after an earlier message to Synergi's general mailbox failed delivery. I noted Synergi's current executive-search activity across the GCC and your direct contact route, so I wanted to place my profile with you personally for relevant senior mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope spans ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, government and regulatory relations, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major international mining operation.

My work sits at the intersection of international investment, government, regulators, communities and operating teams. I lead and coordinate high-scrutiny stakeholder and regulatory matters, institutional relationships, social performance, reputation, sustainability initiatives and cross-functional execution. I also support governance and external positioning around AGM's approximately 46-50 MWp solar platform and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside carbon-accounting work.

I am exploring senior leadership appointments across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my current GCC executive CV. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming searches where institutional leadership, government interface, ESG, stakeholder trust and disciplined country execution are central to the mandate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
